Instagram.notes: 4:5 feed posts, square alternatives, 9:16 Stories/Reels covers, six-slide carousels, avatars and Highlights. Use vertical MP4s for Reels.

Facebook.notes: Feed graphics, 9:16 Stories, page covers and silent video edits.

LinkedIn.notes: 1200x627 feed graphics, 4:5 alternatives, six-page carousel PDFs, personal and company banners.

X.notes: Landscape posts, 1500x500 header, avatar and short copy.

Threads.notes: Square and portrait graphics; use conversational short copy.

Bluesky.notes: Landscape posts, a 1500x500 header and short copy. Check the profile crop in-app.

Mastodon.notes: Landscape posts and square avatar. Header crops and upload limits vary by instance.

TikTok.notes: 1080x1920 silent video posts, covers, title cards and avatar. Add platform-licensed audio if desired.

YouTube.notes: Shorts videos, 1280x720 thumbnails, 2560x1440 banner and avatar. Banner text is within a conservative central safe region.

Snapchat.notes: 9:16 Story graphics and silent videos. Preview app overlays before posting.

WhatsApp.notes: 9:16 Status graphics/videos and square business avatar.

Google Business Profile.notes: Square update images, profile copy and project links. Preview platform cropping.

Reddit.notes: Landscape images and square avatar. Adapt copy to the community and its posting rules.

Behance.notes: 3200x410 profile banner, project-story carousel images and 1600x1200 overview shots.

Dribbble.notes: 1600x1200 studio shots plus avatar. Source work is presented as Capra work.

Twitch.notes: 1200x480 profile banner, square avatar and video title cards.

Discord.notes: Community graphics, square icon and 960x540 banner master. Profile/server features may crop differently.

Telegram.notes: Channel avatar, square/portrait posts and 9:16 Story masters.

Substack / email.notes: Newsletter headers, campaign banners, studio copy and six email drafts.

Zoom / Meet / Teams.notes: 1920x1080 meeting backgrounds keep the middle clear for the speaker.
